Title: Operation Blue Sky
Description: Extract flight data from a rival aerospace firm.
FlavorText: Just a standard grab and run. Don't trigger the alarms.

Title: Hostile Takeover Prep
Description: Plant incriminating evidence on a CEO's personal server.
FlavorText: Make it look like he was embezzling. The board needs a reason to fire him.

Title: Deep Dive Data Recovery
Description: Recover lost research data from a corrupted deep-net node.
FlavorText: The node is unstable. Get in, get the data, get out before it crashes.

Title: Prototype Schematics Theft
Description: Steal the blueprints for a new drone engine.
FlavorText: This is high-level tech. Expect heavy encryption.

Title: Grid Shutdown
Description: Disrupt the power grid of a corporate headquarters.
FlavorText: Lights out. Let's see how they like working in the dark.

Title: Financial Record Alteration
Description: Modify the quarterly earnings report before it's released.
FlavorText: Just a few zeros here and there. No one will notice until it's too late.

Title: Satellite Uplink Intercept
Description: Intercept communications from a competitor's satellite.
FlavorText: They think their signal is secure. Prove them wrong.

Title: Server Farm Overload
Description: Overheat the cooling systems of a data center.
FlavorText: Burn it down. Digitally speaking.

Title: Executive Email Leak
Description: Expose confidential emails to the public.
FlavorText: The public has a right to know what they're hiding.

Title: Supply Chain disruption
Description: Reroute a shipment of rare earth metals.
FlavorText: They won't miss a few tons of refined ore.

Title: AI Algorithm Corruption
Description: Introduce a subtle bias into a trading algorithm.
FlavorText: Make it make bad trades, but slowly. Bleed them dry.

Title: Patent Filing Delay
Description: Hack the patent office database to delay a competitor's filing.
FlavorText: We need more time. Buy us a week.

Title: Chemical Formula Theft
Description: Steal the formula for a new pharmaceutical drug.
FlavorText: This could save lives... or make us a fortune.

Title: Network Traffic Jam
Description: Flood a corporate network with junk data.
FlavorText: Bring their productivity to a halt.

Title: Board Meeting Surveillance
Description: Bug the virtual boardroom during a merger discussion.
FlavorText: We need to know their price before we make an offer.

Title: Fuel Efficiency Data Heist
Description: Steal data on a new fuel-efficient engine design.
FlavorText: Green energy is big business.

Title: Crypto Exchange Hack
Description: Drain a hot wallet from a minor exchange.
FlavorText: High risk, high reward. Don't get traced.

Title: Reputation Smear Campaign
Description: Plant fake reviews and scandals for a target company.
FlavorText: Destroy their image. Make them untouchable.

Title: Drone Navigation Override
Description: Redirect a delivery drone to a new location.
FlavorText: Free shipping, courtesy of the competition.

Title: Security System Bypass
Description: Disable the biometric scanners for a secure facility.
FlavorText: Open the door. We'll handle the rest.
